title: DemoGod Feature Showcase
description: Live demo showcasing layout modes, model switching, code exploration, editing, and sub-agents. Point project at demo/sample-app first.

steps.text: What is this project? Give me a quick summary.
Open src/store.js and explain the TaskStore class
Run the tests and tell me if they all pass
Find all TODOs and FIXMEs in the codebase. Summarize them.
Add a priority field (1-3) to TaskStore.add() and update the tests to cover it
Run the tests again to make sure your changes work
Do a security review and a code quality check on this project in parallel using sub-agents
